verdict.rationale: Stable documents a REST API authenticated with dashboard-created API keys sent in the x-api-key header. It also offers webhooks and pollable endpoints, so scripts can drive it headlessly. However, the documented API scope is narrow: searching and retrieving MailItems, creating and onboarding Locations, and managing Companies. Core mailbox actions (scan, forward, shred, deposit) are not shown as automatable, and there is no CLI or CI-specific guidance. Missing for 10: API coverage of core mail actions, a CLI or CI/automation docs, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
